rows.title_full:
AN ACT ESTABLISHING A SUSTAINABLE RETIREMENT AND PENSION SYSTEM BY
AMENDING PERTINENT LAWS ON THE RETIREMENT BENEFITS AND PENSION OF
THE UNIFORMED PERSONNEL OF THE UNIFORMED SERVICES AND PROVIDING
FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Seeks to reform the benefit and pension system in the uniformed service; Proposes to create a Uniformed Personnel Retirement Fund that shall be financed primarily through mandatory contributions from active members of uniformed service.
Provides a rationalized adjustment of retirement benefits and pension; and an automatic review of pension and benefits two years after retirement and every two years thereafter.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08969
